event.title: Fixed-neighborhood-cover lane removes semantic oracle by exact input-relative enumeration
statement: The direct parity encoding contributes 2^(Delta-1) wrong-parity clauses per output, hence 2^Delta <= 2N for actual encoded input length N.
A macro with explicit verified cover size <= fixed universal C has support size <= C*Delta.
Exact residual nonconstancy can therefore be found by exhaustive evaluation in at most 2^(C*Delta) <= (2N)^C assignments, times polynomial circuit-evaluation cost.
For fixed C this is deterministic polynomial time in original N and needs no semantic oracle or backtracking for the survival test.
Candidate NOT/AND pairs are polynomially enumerable in explicit state size V.
barrier_and_open_front: C=1 is already insufficient as a universal escape in the stated NW-local ER3 scope.
No theorem currently excludes every fixed C>1.
No theorem currently proves that some fixed C>1 is universally sufficient.
If required cover c(N) grows, the exact-enumeration route costs N^O(c(N)); this is the newly exposed hidden exponent.
Semantic survival is still not a global proof-progress potential.
